description: This file documents the 'Download' class in the Playwright API, including its methods, lifecycle, and usage examples across different programming languages. It serves as reference documentation rather than executable source code.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Represents a download object in Playwright, providing methods to control and inspect a download, such as saving, deleting, or querying download details.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download. Does not fail if the download is already finished or canceled. Resolves to 'canceled' if successful.

methods.name: createReadStream
methods.description: Returns a readable stream for the download. Throws if the download failed or was canceled.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the downloaded file, waiting for download completion if necessary.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Returns error details if the download failed or was canceled; otherwise, null.

methods.name: page
methods.description: Returns the page object that initiated the download.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Returns the file path of a successful download; throws if failed or canceled. Waits for download to finish if needed.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Saves (copies) the download to a specified location. Can be called while download is in progress; waits for completion if needed.

methods.name: suggestedFilename
methods.description: Provides the suggested filename for the download based on the response headers or attribute.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL from which the download originated.
